g.title: cluster_agents
g.text: Specialised LLM agents (SW-1: strict JSON schema, 1 retry)

g.title: cluster_hitl
g.text: Human SOC analysts (WF-2, role matrix enforced server-side)

g.title: exc
g.text: Exception queue (manual triage) — invalid input, injection, agent failure, guardrail breach

g.title: tools
g.text: Tool lookups: TI, CMDB, identity, alert history

g.title: score
g.text: Scoring F1-F7 + overrides R1-R4 → LOW / MED / HIGH / CRIT

g.title: appr
g.text: Tier 2 / Lead approve, modify or reject (HIGH / CRIT)

g.title: sla
g.text: SLA watcher: unapproved > 10 min → SOC Lead

g.title: audit
g.text: Audit trail: every step, model, prompt version, decision
